aboutParagraphs: Allen's Independence Air is an owner-operated heating and cooling company on Bloomington's west side, on N. Curry Pike.

"I am the owner, service technician, installer, systems designer, sheet metal fabricator and sales representative." That means the person who designs your system is the same person who builds the ductwork, installs the equipment and answers the phone if you ever need us.
We're a Heil Authorized Dealer and work on conventional systems and geothermal alike.
